olivia: Morning — Olivia here, first day on runtime. Building from source on Ubuntu 22.04; cmake completes but link fails with nvcc/ld noise. Anyone know this one?

olivia: log snippet:```
[ 84%] Linking CXX executable bin/runtime_server
/usr/bin/ld: /usr/local/cuda/lib64/libcudart_static.a: relocation R_X86_64_PC32 against symbol `__cudaRegisterLinkedBinary' can not be used when making a shared object; recompile with -fPIC
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```

paige: welcome! :wave: that static libcudart error usually means mixing static libs into shared objects without -fPIC. Did you install CUDA via runfile or apt?

olivia: runfile for 12.1, symlinked /usr/local/cuda -> /usr/local/cuda-12.1, set gcc-11 as alternative.

mike: two things to try: disable ccache (`ccache -C`) and rebuild; or temporarily set `-DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF` for a dev build. Also ensure CC/CXX point to gcc-11/g++-11.

olivia: cleared ccache and retried. New error:```
ptxas fatal : Unsupported gpu architecture 'compute_86'
error: command '/usr/local/cuda/bin/ptxas' failed with exit status 255
```

paige: means the ptxas on PATH doesn't support sm_86. Check `which -a ptxas` and `ptxas --version`.

olivia: `which -a ptxas` shows `/usr/local/cuda-11.4/bin/ptxas` first and `/usr/local/cuda/bin/ptxas` second. Oops, leftover 11.4 in PATH.

mike: fix PATH so `/usr/local/cuda-12.1/bin` is first, or remove the old install. Then verify `nvcc --version` and `ptxas --version`. Also watch LD_LIBRARY_PATH for old libs.

olivia: updated PATH, cleared ccache, reconfigured — build now completes past link. One small PIC warning on a vendor static lib but binary works.

paige: nice. Action: add onboarding checklist steps: verify `which -a ptxas`, `ptxas --version`, `nvcc --version`, and clear ccache if needed. Also recommend using our devcontainer image.

olivia: I'll open a tiny PR to add a shell sanity-check and the checklist item. @infra-bot any chance for a pinned devcontainer for cuda-12.1?

infra-bot: queued devcontainer build tag `devcontainer/cuda-12.1` — will post artifact link when ready.
